# TASK-642: Serve live capacity independent of the detail store

## Goal

Make capacity a separate read path: get_storage_summary, the helper self-check and the board return the live volume sample with a detail status even when the detail store is missing, locked, corrupt, over budget or its summary refuses.

## Deliverables

- Independent capacity read path in IPC, helper and board
- Fault-injection evidence

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-TASK-642-01` — For each detail fault (missing, locked, corrupt, summary refused, over cap) get_storage_summary returns live capacity with detail status unavailable and a reason, and never presents a capacity value older than its sample.
- `AC-TASK-642-02` — The helper self-check proves connectivity from the capacity read and reports detail freshness separately, so the integration verifies while detail evidence is unavailable; the board keeps live capacity in the same faults.

## Required Evidence

- `EVREQ-TASK-642-01` (regression-evidence) — Fault-injection fixtures over the real socket for each fault, plus the self-check against a refused summary.
- `EVREQ-TASK-642-02` (regression-evidence) — Mutation red showing the coupled path fails the fixture.
